_about: Where the daily run finds Bay View listings (Ben, Nov. 25, 2026: agents' and brokers' own public posts and listing pages only). Zillow, Redfin, Realtor.com and Homes.com don't allow automated collection, so they are not sources; never read them. Coverage: inside the Bulletin's boundary (harbor/Jones Island south to Holt and Morgan, I-43 east to the lake), ZIP 53207 and the Bay View part of 53204.
